scope: Slice 1 Stage 4 dual baselines (Tol-side regression + FunC-vs-Tol parity)
note: Schema v2 adds the FunC-vs-Tol parity baseline (recommended in doc/slice-1-gas-gap.md §4) alongside the v1 Tol-side regression gate. The Tol-side baseline (`baseline_gas`) is the focused tol-tester run total, gated by `threshold_percent`. The dual baselines (`tol_gas_baseline`, `func_gas_baseline`) are the per-contract sums of `Answer.gas_used` across the recv_internal scenarios in emulator/test/slice-1-stage-4-gas-parity-fixture.cpp; gated by `func_vs_tol_ratio_threshold` (default 1.15 per §10.1). Per-contract `func_vs_tol_ratio_threshold` overrides the default; wallet-v5 uses 1.35 because its bytecode-cell ratio is 1.10 (the only reference contract that grew during migration, per doc/tos-message-envelope-migration.md) and the fixed DECLMETHOD dispatcher overhead amplifies the bytecode delta on short fast-paths into a runtime gas delta closer to 1.30.
